verdict.rationale: Semgrep AppSec Platform is a SaaS service, so outbound webhooks are a fair axis. However, the evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks. The only related items are a generic mention of 'alerts and notifications or create tickets' (an adjacent feature, not webhooks) and a pull-based REST API for listing findings, neither of which lets a programmatic consumer subscribe to events.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
